ns0:section.ns0:heading: Sixth amendment rights

ns0:content.ns0:p: No provision of this chapter shall be interpreted as a bar to any claim of denial of speedy trial as required by amendment VI of the Constitution.

ns0:section.ns0:sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 93–619, title I, § 101, Jan. 3, 1975, 88 Stat. 2085.)
